title.zh: 将卡皮斯省蓬特韦德拉市镇马阿永村马阿永村学校的名称变更为Arturo Cantiller纪念学校的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Maayon Barrio School in the Barrio of Maayon, Municipality of Pontevedra, Province of Capiz, to Arturo Cantiller Memorial School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Maayon Barrio School in the Barrio of Maayon, Municipality of Pontevedra, Province of Capiz, to Arturo Cantiller Memorial School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Maayon Barrio School tại Barrio Maayon, Thị trấn Pontevedra, Tỉnh Capiz thành Arturo Cantiller Memorial School
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อ Maayon Barrio School ในบารริโอ Maayon, เทศบาล Pontevedra, จังหวัด Capiz เป็น Arturo Cantiller Memorial School
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Maayon Barrio School di Barrio Maayon, Kotamadya Pontevedra, Provinsi Capiz menjadi Arturo Cantiller Memorial School
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Maayon Barrio School di Barrio Maayon, Perbandaran Pontevedra, Wilayah Capiz menjadi Arturo Cantiller Memorial School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1957/ra_1636_1957.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Maayon Barrio School in the barrio of Maayon, Municipality of Pontevedra, Province of Capiz, is hereby changed to Arturo Cantiller Memorial School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 20, 1957.
